# Orange Dev Network | Bitcoin Technical Influence Map

Orange Dev Network is an interactive visualization tool that maps the social and technical influence hubs within the Bitcoin R&D ecosystem. By analyzing over 15 years of technical discussions from the Bitcoin-dev mailing list and Delving Bitcoin, it reveals the hidden structures of peer review and technical authority.

## Core Purpose
- **Visualize Influence**: Identifying "Influence Hubs" based on reply-weighted network graphs.
- **Trace Evolution**: Categorizing 27,000+ technical messages into key technical milestones (SegWit, Taproot, Covenants, etc.).
- **Map Expertise**: Linking proposal authors to their social and technical contributions.

## Technical Stats
- **Data Source**: Bitcoin-dev mailing list (2011–Present) and Delving Bitcoin (2024–Present).
- **Message Count**: 27,172 messages.
- **Contributor Base**: 1,523 unique technical contributors.
- **Top Categories**: Mining, Mempool/Fees, Block Size Debate, Covenants, Taproot.
